title: Countable cover of an open set by open subsets of finite mass (μ finite on compact subsets)
statement: Let N ∈ ℕ and let μ be a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N (Euclidean metric, Borel σ-algebra). Let U ⊆ ℝ^N be open with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there is a sequence (W_i)_{i∈ℕ} of open sets with W_i ⊆ U and μ(W_i) < ∞ for every i, and U ⊆ ⋃_{i∈ℕ} W_i.
lean_statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclidean N), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∃ W : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N), (∀ i, IsOpen (W i) ∧ W i ⊆ U ∧ μ (W i) ≠ ∞) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ i, W i
